artifacts.summary: Hard-mode Lean research: verbatim stability-modal ground truth (paper line 1114), full file:line inventory of the landed L/L+ metatheory (zero structural sorry), Tier-1 literature mapping table, architecture decision (separate StarFormula inductive + ofFormula embedding, mirroring BaseLanguage/tr), precise conservativity statements (L<L+ forward refuted/open, L+<L* forward provable from soundness + existing completeness engines), verified Mathlib names, three compiled lean_run_code prototypes, online survey (nothing reusable), and a 9-phase outline with TM* completeness as a gated spike.

key_decisions: Architecture (b): separate StarFormula inductive with constructor-to-constructor embedding ofFormula; no change to Formula or BLFormula
L<L+ conservativity delivered semantically (landed) and via the L-fragment logic TMFrag; proof-theoretic forward direction is refuted at Base/Discrete and must not be attempted
L+<L* proof-theoretic conservativity is provable in both directions now; the forward direction uses TM* soundness + existing WeakCompleteness engines, not TM* completeness
TM* completeness is research-grade (no paper axiomatization; nearest relative Zanardo 1991 Ockhamist S/U) and is scoped as a gated spike phase; TM* decidability out of scope

memory_candidates.title: Forward conservativity via soundness-plus-base-completeness
memory_candidates.content: For a syntactic language extension e : L1 -> L2 with a truth-transfer lemma (truth of e(phi) iff truth of phi), the hard direction of proof-theoretic conservativity (L2 |- e(phi) implies L1 |- phi) follows from L2 soundness plus L1 completeness alone; it never needs L2 completeness. In BimodalLogic this makes TM* conservative over TM+ cheap (engines completeness_base/dense/discrete/dedekind), while the same route fails for TM+ over TM because TM is incomplete over task frames (tmComplete_iff_forward).

memory_candidates.title: Language extension pattern in BimodalLogic: separate inductive plus embedding
memory_candidates.content: Adding an operator to FormalSystem.Syntax.Formula would touch ~414 constructor match arms in 57 files; the repository's validated pattern is a separate inductive (BLFormula, proposed StarFormula) with an explicit embedding (tr, ofFormula), native truth recursion, a truth-transfer lemma, and a structural-recursion backward bridge on derivation trees. Constructor-to-constructor embeddings (L+ into L*) need no axiom-discharge bridge; definitional ones (H/G via untl/snce) do (AxiomDischarge.lean's notGNot_imp_F).

memory_candidates.title: Stability modal semantics on task frames
memory_candidates.content: Paper line 1114: M,tau,x |= [.]phi iff M,sigma,x |= phi for all total sigma with sigma(x)=tau(x). In Lean: SameStateAt tau sigma t := forall proofs of domain membership, tau.states t _ = sigma.states t _; clause: forall sigma, sigma.IsTotal -> SameStateAt tau sigma t -> StarTruthAt M sigma t phi. Valid by definition: T, 4, 5, box phi -> [.]phi, p -> [.]p for atoms; time-shift invariance is Iff.rfl. No valid tense interaction; [.]phi -> box [.]phi is invalid.
